Yes, under the standard rules: the host knows where the car is, always opens a door with a goat, and always offers the switch. Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, and the host's reveal doesn't change that, so switching wins the other 2/3.

The result depends on those rules. If the host opens a door at random and merely happens to reveal a goat, switching and staying are each 1/2. If he offers the switch only when it suits him, the odds depend on his strategy.
